Sheriff or Murderer 🔪

🔍 Can you survive and uncover the murderer?

Play as the Sheriff, Murderer, or Innocent in this exciting mystery survival game!

🔪 Murderer – Eliminate everyone without getting caught!

🔫 Sheriff – Protect the innocents and stop the murderer!

🏃 Innocent – Stay alive, avoid the murderer, and help the sheriff!

🏆 Win rounds and prove your skills!

⭐ Like and favorite the game!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like!

👥 Invite your friends and see who survives!

Will you survive or become the next victim?

PLUS USERS GET SPECIAL TITLE CALLED [ELITE+]
